target: consumption_mwh: total electricity consumption (grid load) per day, MWh
calendar: Europe/Berlin calendar days; clock-change days have 23 or 25 hours, kept as published

assumptions.available_at: a day's value is known at 12:00 UTC the next day (the source gives no publication time)
assumptions.revisions: recent days may be revised by the source; each retrieval is a version (raw_sha256)

not_used: no weather, prices or holidays: only the series' own history
